name: Skin-Walker (Brave Archetype)
body:
Skin-walkers are practitioners of an evil spiritual practice that allows them to shift their form into that of any animal they desire. They are humans who give in to the animalistic side that lurks in the heart of all men. Most kill for sport and pleasure rather than need.

Required Alignment: Any evil

White Ash Vulnerability

A skin-walker is vulnerable to weapons coated in white ash. He takes +2d6 damage from weapons so anointed. Anointing a medium sized-weapon (or 5 rounds of ammunition) in white ash takes 1 minute and the remains of a campfire sized for a medium humanoids. White ash remains on a weapon until it strikes its target. A skin-walker who has wildshaped must make a Will save (DC 25 + 5 if they have taken damage from a white ash weapon within the last 24 hours) to remain in their wildshaped form.

Evil Eyes (Su)

At 1st level skin-walker gains darkvision 60 ft. If he already has darkvision or gains it from another source he instead gains 120 ft. If a skin walker would have 120 ft already he instead gains a +4 on visual Perception checks made in dark areas. A skin-walker’s eyes take on an animalistic quality when they gain this class feature.

This replaces the fearless class feature of the brave.

Skin-Walking (Su)

A brave with the skin-walker archetype loses access to his medicine man class feature. In exchange he gains the wild shape ability of the druid at 4th level. The skin-walker can use this ability a number of times per day that a druid of his level can use it and must follow the same restrictions on the forms he may take. Unlike a druid, a skin-walker must pay 2 coup points in order to transform though they may circumvent this cost by cloaking themselves in the pelt of the creature they wish to transform into with wild shape (i.e. wearing the pelt of a bear means you do not need to pay 2 coup points to turn into a bear).

This only functions for creatures with pelts (elementals or plants do not have them for example) and the pelt must be sizable enough that the skin-walker can wear it as an article of clothing (robe, cloak, shirt, pants). This may require that the skin-walker stitch together the hides of multiple creatures of the same type to make a suitable garment for this ability.

Ways of Witchery (Sp)

At 1st level a skin-walker can expend coup points to cast any of the following spells as a spell-like ability using his skin-walker level as his caster level:

1st Level: flare (1 coup), ghost sound (1 coup), prestidigitation (1 coup), 3rd Level: Call animal (2 coup), charm animal (2 coup), magic fang (4 coup) 5th Level: Dominate animal (4 coup)

The replaces the brave’s medicine man class feature.

Natural Weapon Training (Ex)

A brave’s brave weapon training class feature applies to the skin-walker’s natural weapons while in wildshape rather than to the native weapon group.

This modifies the brave’s brave weapon training class feature.
